parameters.query:
-- Probable duplicate listings (2026-09-11: tolerant match). Two active,
-- non-excluded stocks on the same exchange whose candles agree on close,
-- high and low to the tick AND whose volumes are within 0.05% of each other
-- on >= 15 of the last ~30 sessions, OR that carry the same company name.
-- The exact-equality version missed MEDP/MEPA (Medical Packaging Company,
-- 2026-09-08): the provider's two feeds for the same security differed by a
-- few shares of volume on most days. Flags only — set stocks.excluded = TRUE
-- (and active = FALSE) on the alias symbol by hand; wf01 then honours it.
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT stock_id, trading_date, close, high, low, volume
  FROM daily_prices WHERE trading_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '45 days'
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT a.stock_id AS id1, b.stock_id AS id2, COUNT(*)::int AS same_days
  FROM recent a JOIN recent b ON b.trading_date = a.trading_date AND b.stock_id > a.stock_id
    AND b.close = a.close AND b.high = a.high AND b.low = a.low
    AND ABS(b.volume - a.volume) <= GREATEST(1, 0.0005 * GREATEST(a.volume, b.volume))
  GROUP BY a.stock_id, b.stock_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15
),
name_pairs AS (
  SELECT s1.id AS id1, s2.id AS id2, 0 AS same_days
  FROM stocks s1 JOIN stocks s2 ON s2.exchange = s1.exchange AND s2.id > s1.id
    AND lower(trim(s2.name)) = lower(trim(s1.name)) AND s1.name IS NOT NULL AND s1.name <> ''
  WHERE s1.active AND s2.active AND NOT s1.excluded AND NOT s2.excluded
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT s1.symbol AS sym1, s2.symbol AS sym2, s1.exchange, MAX(p.same_days) AS same_days,
         bool_or(p.same_days = 0) AS name_match, bool_or(p.same_days > 0) AS candle_match
  FROM (SELECT * FROM pairs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM name_pairs) p
  JOIN stocks s1 ON s1.id = p.id1 JOIN stocks s2 ON s2.id = p.id2
  WHERE s1.exchange = s2.exchange AND s1.active AND s2.active AND NOT s1.excluded AND NOT s2.excluded
  GROUP BY s1.symbol, s2.symbol, s1.exchange
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow_name, symbol, error_message, payload)
  SELECT '19-egx-data-quality-audit', f.sym1 || '/' || f.sym2,
         'Probable duplicate listing: ' || CASE WHEN f.candle_match THEN 'near-identical OHLCV on ' || f.same_days || ' of the last ~30 sessions' ELSE 'same company name' END
         || CASE WHEN f.candle_match AND f.name_match THEN ' and same company name' ELSE '' END
         || '. Review and set stocks.excluded = TRUE (and active = FALSE) on the alias symbol.',
         jsonb_build_object('exchange', f.exchange, 'symbols', ARRAY[f.sym1, f.sym2], 'sameDays', f.same_days, 'nameMatch', f.name_match)
  FROM flagged f RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins)::int AS ohlcv_pairs_flagged;

WITH isin_pairs AS (SELECT s1.id AS id1, s2.id AS id2, s1.symbol AS sym1, s2.symbol AS sym2, s1.exchange, s1.isin FROM stocks s1 JOIN stocks s2 ON s2.exchange = s1.exchange AND s2.isin = s1.isin AND s2.id > s1.id WHERE s1.active AND s2.active AND NOT s1.excluded AND NOT s2.excluded AND s1.isin IS NOT NULL AND s1.isin <> ''), enriched AS (SELECT p.*, (SELECT MAX(trading_date) FROM daily_prices WHERE stock_id = p.id1) AS last1, (SELECT MAX(trading_date) FROM daily_prices WHERE stock_id = p.id2) AS last2 FROM isin_pairs p), stale AS (SELECT * FROM enriched WHERE LEAST(last1, last2) < CURRENT_DATE - 10), ins AS (INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow_name, symbol, error_message, payload) SELECT '19-egx-data-quality-audit', s.sym1 || '/' || s.sym2, 'Shared ISIN ' || s.isin || ' and one side has no prices in 10+ days - likely a ticker rename leftover. Review and set stocks.excluded on the stale symbol.', jsonb_build_object('exchange', s.exchange, 'symbols', ARRAY[s.sym1, s.sym2], 'isin', s.isin, 'lastPriceDays', ARRAY[s.last1::text, s.last2::text]) FROM stale s RETURNING 1) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins)::int AS stale_isin_pairs_flagged;
